title: Connector length limit.
officialText:
The vent connector shall be routed to the vent utilizing the shortest possible route. Except as
provided in Section 504.3.3, the maximum vent connector horizontal length shall be 1½ feet for each inch (18 mm per mm) of
connector diameter as shown in Table 504.3.2.
TABLE 504.3.2
MAXIMUM VENT CONNECTOR LENGTH
CONNECTOR DIAMETER MAXIMUM CONNECTOR HORIZONTAL
(inches) LENGTH (feet)
3 41/2
4 6
5 71/2
6 9

8 12
9 131/2
10 15
12 18
14 21
16 24
18 27
20 30

24 36
For SI: 1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 foot = 304.8 mm.
